# Is In Alternate Form

Source: [4645](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4645); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Is In Alternate Form](../../api/values/is-in-alternate-form.md).

<a id="wiki-4645-n1"></a>

- Alternate form covers hero-specific weapon/form modes, including Pilot D.Va, ball form, Lucio speed song, Mercy pistol, Torbjorn hammer and Lifeweaver thorn volley.

<a id="wiki-4645-n2"></a>

- Echo duplication must be checked through Is Duplicating instead.

Source limitations:

- List includes legacy Bastion tank/turret forms and omits other possible newer forms; treat examples as historical, not exhaustive.
